description: This file contains a PHP interface definition for OperatorEscapeInterface within the Twig templating engine. It specifies a contract for n-ary operators related to escaping operations, primarily providing a method to get operand names to escape.

classes.name: OperatorEscapeInterface
classes.description: An interface for n-ary operator classes that handle escape-related operations, requiring implementation of method to retrieve operand names to escape.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns a list of operand names that need to be escaped, as part of the escaping process in the Twig engine.
